text:
Pri (AE): Heads-up- Enterprise prospect 'BlueHarbor' asked for SIG/CAIQ, SOC2 link, our incident response flow, and whether Redwood can hold KMS keys during a 30-day POC. Procurement wants a firm notification SLA. Need a short bundle by 9am PT tomorrow.

Noah (Security): I can do SIG/CAIQ answers. Short answer on keys: BYOK is default for VPC; holding keys (escrow) is possible as an exception but requires Legal & Risk approval plus PS to manage lifecycle.

Pri (AE): They specifically asked: "If Redwood detects a breach that affects our data, when will we be notified?" Please include exact copy in the packet.

Vik (Solutions): POC config: VPC with customer-managed KMS recommended. If escrow is requested we'll propose a scoped add-on: HSM-backed escrow, strict access controls, deletion certificate at POC end. Pricing: 4-week POC, 3 GPU nodes, 30% off reserved POC rate + two enablement sessions; escrow add-on = one-time fee + PS days.

Rachel (Legal): Key escrow increases risk. We can offer it only with a narrow addendum: limited purpose, deletion certificate, elevated indemnity or liability cap change, and clear forensic cooperation obligations. Recommend leading with BYOK; escrow as a paid, auditable option.

Noah (Security): IR timeline (short, for procurement):
```
- Acknowledge detection: within 1 hour
- Triage & scope: 0-24 hours
- Contain: ongoing, goal within 24 hours
- Customer notification: within 72 hours of confirmed impact
- Post-incident report: within 14 days
Contacts: security@redwood.ai, ir-oncall@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai, comms@redwood.ai
```
Note: we can present an "enterprise SLA" option of 48 hours notification but only with contractually agreed higher liability cap + active customer cooperation on forensics. I'll attach a short IR playbook excerpt.

Pri (AE): Procurement is pushing for 48h flat. Can we list both options in the packet?

Rachel (Legal): Yes. I'll draft two short clauses: (A) Standard: "Redwood will notify Customer within 72 hours of confirmed data-impacting incidents." (B) Enterprise SLA: "Redwood will notify Customer within 48 hours of confirmed data-impacting incidents provided Customer accepts increased liability cap and cooperates in forensic investigations." I'll include escrow addendum bullets.

Vik (Solutions): Also include SOC2 redacted link and latest pentest date. That helps procurement sign off.

Noah (Security): SOC2 (redacted): https://files.redwood/security/soc2-redacted-2026.pdf. Latest pentest: 2026-04-09. Uploading SIG answers and IR excerpt now.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Files uploaded: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/blueharbor-sig-caiq-1783002222.pdf, https://files.redwood/sales/poc/blueharbor-poc-sow-1783002222.pdf

Pri (AE): Nice. For the packet I'll include: SIG/CAIQ answers, SOC2 link, IR timeline + clause options, SOW/pricing, and escrow add-on terms. Order: suggest pushing BYOK first, escrow as optional paid service.

Noah (Security): In SIG/CAIQ I'll mark controls that are Private-only and add compensating controls (detailed audit logs, RBAC, PS access controls). Will include IR tabletop frequency and post-mortem timeline.

Rachel (Legal): I'll add deletion certificate language: if escrow used, Redwood will provide a signed deletion certificate within 7 days of POC termination confirming key destruction. Also add the forensics cooperation clause.

Pri (AE): Thanks. Target: send packet to BlueHarbor 08:45 PT tomorrow. Noah/Rachel/Vik - please finalize tonight.

Vik (Solutions): Will finalize SOW and price note (include 2 training seats). Also note PII/data policy: no production data in POC unless explicitly approved and documented.

Noah (Security): Will add contact matrix for incident notifications and a short note on encryption (BYOK for VPC; BYOK/HSM integration for Private).

Pri (AE): Great. If BlueHarbor insists on escrow w/out indemnity we'd decline and push BYOK + assisted onboarding. Thanks team :pray:
